**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Article II grant package satisfies the preferred position on all material terms:

- **Affiliates:** covered as of right (Section 2.2(a) allows sublicensing to Affiliates without consent; 2.1(b) is expressly sublicensable to Affiliates) — stronger than the fallback's "affiliates on written notice."
- **Contractors:** 2.1(b) expressly permits extension to Third Party manufacturers "on Ono's behalf," and the Subcontractor definition (1.57) plus Articles IV/IX contemplate performance through Subcontractors.
- **Not revocable at will:** Array may terminate only for uncured material breach (13.3) or bankruptcy (13.4); the at-will and safety/efficacy termination rights belong to us (13.2, 13.5). On expiry the Section 2.1 licences become "fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual, royalty free licenses, with sublicensing rights" (13.1).
- **Successor transfer:** Section 18.9 permits assignment without consent to an acquirer of substantially all business or assets by merger or acquisition, and the Agreement inures to successors and permitted assigns.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations: engaging a Third Party as Sublicensee or distributor requires Array's prior written consent, and the licences exclude modification of the compounds (2.1(d)) — ordinary field limits, not an exclusion of affiliates/contractors without a path to add them.
